name: sg_list_add_contact
description: Add an existing marketing contact to a contact list and update the list's contact count. Returns the membership record; adding a contact that is already a member is a no-op. (PUT /v3/marketing/contacts with list_ids)

list_id.description: The ID of the list the contact should be added to.

contact_id.description: The ID of an existing marketing contact to add to the list.
